description: Source code for the Android ResourceObserverService, managing media resource observation, registration, unregistration, and notification of resource status changes.

classes.name: ResourceObserverService::DeathRecipient
classes.description: Handles death notifications for resource observers, unregistering them upon binder death.

methods.name: getObservableType
methods.description: Determines the observable type based on resource subtype and type.

methods.name: BinderDiedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a binder (observer) dies, triggers unregistration.

methods.name: instantiate
methods.description: Creates and registers an instance of ResourceObserverService with the Android service manager.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs current state and registered observers, requires dump permission.

methods.name: registerObserver
methods.description: Registers a new resource observer with specified filters, sets up death notification.

methods.name: unregisterObserver
methods.description: Unregisters an existing resource observer and cleans up associated data.

methods.name: notifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies registered observers of resource status changes based on events.

methods.name: onResourceAdded
methods.description: Handles resource addition event, triggers busy notification.

methods.name: onResourceRemoved
methods.description: Handles resource removal event, triggers idle notification.
